space.noHome: This space has no home page.
space.keyHelp: 2-10 characters starting with a capital letter (used in URLs and wiki links; cannot change later)

page.moveBody: Pick the new parent page. Child pages move along, and the page goes last in its new place.

editor.title: Title
editor.errorsBlock: Errors must be fixed before saving
editor.placeholder: Write Markdown. Type [[ to link a page.
editor.yamlBroken: The frontmatter YAML has an error. Fix it in the editor.
editor.draftOutdated: The page was saved again since then.
editor.renamedLinks: {{count}} page(s) still link to the old title (too many to rewrite at once, or archived); those links are broken.
editor.lintFailed: Not saved: fix the errors listed below.
editor.saveFailed: Could not save. Try again shortly.
editor.confirmLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway? (A draft stays in this browser.)
editor.conflictBody: Revision {{theirs}} was saved while you edited revision {{mine}}. Copy your text to the clipboard, load the latest version, and reapply your change.
editor.loadedLatestCopied: Loaded the latest version. Your text is on the clipboard.
editor.readOnly: You do not have permission to edit.
editor.linksUpdated: Updated links to the new title in {{count}} page(s).

lint.frontmatter-missing: The page must start with YAML frontmatter (---).
lint.frontmatter-yaml: The frontmatter YAML has a syntax error.
lint.frontmatter-field: Frontmatter "{{field}}" is missing or not an allowed value.
lint.attachment-exists: Attachment "{{filename}}" does not exist on this page.
lint.no-h1: Do not use H1 (#) in the body; the page title is the H1.
lint.heading-increment: Heading level jumps from H{{from}} to H{{to}}.
lint.code-lang: Code block has no language (e.g. ```ts), so it is not highlighted.
lint.doc-length: The page is {{kb}}KB; consider splitting it into child pages over {{limitKb}}KB.

search.palette: Type a page name or some text
search.shortQuery: Terms under 3 characters use plain substring matching (no index).

trash.help: Deleted pages are kept for {{days}} days, then removed for good. Child pages are restored together.
trash.renamed: Renamed to "{{title}}" because the title was taken.
